pairs: In illa hora accesserunt discipuli ad Jesum, dicentes:
In that hour, the disciples drew near to Jesus,
putas, major est in regno cælorum?
“Whom do you consider to be greater in the kingdom of heaven?”
And Jesus, calling to himself a little child,
you shall not enter into the kingdom of heaven.
Quicumque ergo humiliaverit se sicut parvulus iste,
Therefore, whoever will have humbled himself like this little child,
hic est major in regno cælorum.
such a one is greater in the kingdom of heaven.
Et qui susceperit unum parvulum talem in nomine meo,
And whoever shall accept one such little child in my name,
qui autem scandalizaverit unum de pusillis istis,
But whoever will have led astray one of these little ones,
expedit ei ut suspendatur mola asinaria in collo ejus,
it would be better for him to have a great millstone hung around his neck,
and to be submerged in the depths of the sea.
Woe to a world that leads people astray!
Necesse est enim ut veniant scandala:
Although it is necessary for temptations to arise,
Woe to that man through whom temptation arises!
Si autem manus tua, vel pes tuus scandalizat te,
So if your hand or your foot leads you to sin,
abscide eum, et projice abs te:
cut it off and cast it away from you.
bonum tibi est ad vitam ingredi debilem, vel claudum,
It is better for you to enter into life disabled or lame,
quam duas manus vel duos pedes habentem mitti in ignem æternum.
than to be sent into eternal fire having two hands or two feet.
Et si oculus tuus scandalizat te,
And if your eye leads you to sin,
and cast it away from you.
bonum tibi est cum uno oculo in vitam intrare,
It is better for you to enter into life with one eye,
quam duos oculos habentem mitti in gehennam ignis.
than to be sent into the fires of Hell having two eyes.
Videte ne contemnatis unum ex his pusillis:
See to it that you do not despise even one of these little ones.
quia angeli eorum in cælis semper vident faciem Patris mei,
that their Angels in heaven continually look upon the face of my Father,
Venit enim Filius hominis salvare quod perierat.
For the Son of man has come to save what had been lost.
How does it seem to you?
If someone has one hundred sheep,
and if one of them has gone astray,
nonne relinquit nonaginta novem in montibus,
should he not leave behind the ninety-nine in the mountains,
et vadit quærere eam quæ erravit?
and go out to seek what has gone astray?
Et si contigerit ut inveniat eam:
And if he should happen to find it:
quia gaudet super eam magis quam super nonaginta novem,
that he has more joy over that one,
than over the ninety-nine which did not go astray.
Sic non est voluntas ante Patrem vestrum,
Even so, it is not the will before your Father,
ut pereat unus de pusillis istis.
that one of these little ones should be lost.
Si autem peccaverit in te frater tuus, vade,
But if your brother has sinned against you,
et corripe eum inter te, et ipsum solum:
go and correct him, between you and him alone.
you will have regained your brother.
But if he will not listen you,
so that every word may stand by the mouth of two
vel trium testium stet omne verbum.
And if he will not listen to them,
But if he will not listen to the Church,
sit tibi sicut ethnicus et publicanus.
let him be to you like the pagan and the tax collector.
whatever you will have bound on earth,
shall be bound also in heaven,
and whatever you will have released on earth,
shall be released also in heaven.
quia si duo ex vobis consenserint super terram,
that if two of those among you have agreed on earth,
about anything whatsoever that they have requested,
it shall be done for them by my Father,
For wherever two or three are gathered in my name,
vel tres congregati in nomine meo,
Then Peter, drawing near to him, said:
Domine, quoties peccabit in me frater meus,
how many times shall my brother sin against me,
“I do not say to you, even seven times,
but even seventy times seven times.
Ideo assimilatum est regnum cælorum homini regi,
Therefore, the kingdom of heaven is compared to a man who was king,
qui voluit rationem ponere cum servis suis.
who wanted to take account of his servants.
And when he had begun taking account,
oblatus est ei unus, qui debebat ei decem millia talenta.
one was brought to him who owed him ten thousand talents.
Cum autem non haberet unde redderet,
But since he did not have any way to repay it,
his lord ordered him to be sold,
and I will repay it all to you.’
Then the lord of that servant, being moved with pity,
Egressus autem servus ille invenit unum de conservis suis, qui debebat ei centum denarios:
But when that servant departed, he found one of his fellow servants who owed him one hundred denarius.
And taking hold of him, he choked him,
And his fellow servant, falling prostrate,
and I will repay it all to you.’
et misit eum in carcerem donec redderet debitum.
he went out and had him sent to prison, until he would repay the debt.
Videntes autem conservi ejus quæ fiebant,
et narraverunt domino suo omnia quæ facta fuerant.
and they went and reported to their lord all that was done.
Tunc vocavit illum dominus suus: et ait illi:
Then his lord called him, and he said to him:
omne debitum dimisi tibi quoniam rogasti me:
I forgave you all your debt, because you pleaded with me.
nonne ergo oportuit et te misereri conservi tui,
Therefore, should you not also have had compassion on your fellow servant,
sicut et ego tui misertus sum?
just as I also had compassion on you?’
Et iratus dominus ejus tradidit eum tortoribus,
And his lord, being angry, handed him over to the torturers,
until he repaid the entire debt.
Sic et Pater meus cælestis faciet vobis,
So, too, shall my heavenly Father do to you,
si non remiseritis unusquisque fratri suo de cordibus vestris.
if each one of you will not forgive his brother from your hearts.”
